ms.promise: Organize first Bug Bounty program on Cardano opensource dapp that help identify & improve Cardano dapps. Selected promising opensource DApps will be chosen and everyone are welcome to join to find and report security vulnerabilities in those dapps and get rewards in ADA.
ms.criteria:
- At least 02 dapps are selected to join the Program
- At least 10 developers join the Bug Bounty program
- At least 02 problems found and accepted by the dapps owners
ms.report:
The DanolearnxCatalyst Bug Bounty Challenge 2024 was our first initiative for improving Cardano open-source dApps. The goal was to identify and enhance the security of these dApps by inviting developers to find and report vulnerabilities:
Project Introduction
・Duration: From August 30th, 2024 to October 31st, 2024, 00:00 UTC+7
・Game Rules: Blockchain developers can participate in our program to identify bugs or vulnerabilities in our partner dApps. If they find a bug, they can report it through our contest link. Our internal bounty team will review the report and send it to the dApp owner for confirmation and severity assessment. If the bug is confirmed, the developer who found it will receive a reward from our program. See more
